needs: A side-by-side comparison: two lanes play the same situation with different outcomes.

brief.title: TCP and UDP, side by side
brief.idea: TCP acknowledges and resends every piece so nothing is lost or out of order, while UDP just sends and moves on, which is why calls and games often prefer it.

beats.say: Two programs send the same five packets across a network. The left one uses T C P, the right one U D P.
beats.show: The screen splits into two lanes, each with a sender, a receiver, and five numbered packets waiting.

beats.say: Halfway across, the network drops packet three, in both lanes at the same moment.
beats.show: In both lanes packets travel toward the receiver and packet 3 is lost midway.

beats.say: The T C P receiver sends back an acknowledgement for each packet it gets, and notices that three never arrived.
beats.show: On the left, acknowledgements travel back for 1 and 2, and a gap shows where 3 should be.

beats.say: The sender resends packet three. Four and five wait, so the program reads them in order.
beats.show: Packet 3 travels again on the left while 4 and 5 sit in a holding area until it arrives.

beats.say: In the end it delivers one, two, three, four, five, all in order, just a little later than it could have.
beats.show: The left receiver shows 1 to 5 in order.

beats.say: The U D P receiver sends nothing back. It hands over one, two, four and five as they come.
beats.show: On the right, packets 1, 2, 4 and 5 pass straight to the program with no messages going back.

beats.say: Packet three is simply gone, but nothing ever waited for it, so four and five arrived on time.
beats.show: An empty slot marks where 3 would be on the right, while the left lane is still finishing.

beats.say: T C P suits a web page or a file, where every byte has to arrive, and in order.
beats.show: Under the left lane, a file and a web page appear beside the words every byte, in order.

beats.say: U D P suits a video call or a game, where a late packet is worse than a missing one.
beats.show: Under the right lane, a video call and a game appear beside the words fresh beats complete.

beats.say: Same network, same lost packet. One side waits until it is complete, the other keeps going.
beats.show: Both lanes are shown together once more, the left complete and late, the right on time with a gap.
